title: Jesus... He Ended Three Years With One Text
topic: boyfriend ended a three year relationship over text

bible.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... he ended three years with one text. I replied "okay" so he wouldn't see me cry. 💔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I've read it fifty times, like it might say something else.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Put the phone down. Look at Me instead.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Was I that easy to leave?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: How he left says something about him. It doesn't decide what you're worth.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Tonight you don't have to be okay. Just let Me stay with you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who's rereading an old message tonight. 💔
